==Description==
'''Winter Abyss''' is a dark winter-themed [[Maps|map]]. It effectively replaced [[Winter]].

==Design & Path==
{{Tabber
|Version 2 & 4
|'''Winter Abyss''' is has two big and two smaller islands, connected by wooden bridges. The islands only have a few lanterns, destroyed buildings. The map is surrounded by water and various lower placed ice.

The grey stone path begins and ends at two portals. The path crosses the four islands on wooden bridges. It takes long turns around snow mounds in the middle of the map.
|Version 3 & 1
|'''Winter Abyss''' had two big and two smaller islands, connected by wooden bridges. Some trees and two houses could be seen on the map. In the water surrounding the map there were multiple ice spikes. An aurora borealis could be seen in the sky. One of the caves had icicles on its mouth.

The grey stone path began and ended at two caves in the mountains. The path crossed the four islands on wooden bridges. It took long turns around snow mounds in the middle of the map.
}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Hard|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*Generally, cliff space is limited on this map. Most cliff spots are far apart from each other, meaning it is quite difficult to boost all of your cliff towers with one [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]].
*Ground space is also quite limited.
**The optimal spot to place ground towers near the start of the map or at the end of the map.
**Ground space on the smaller islands is generally quite limiting.
*Towers with high range such as the [[Ranger]] can cover most of the path, despite the limited spots in the middle of the map.
**The [[Pursuit]] can easily cover the entire map as it can be relocated using its ''Patrol'' ability.

==Trivia==
*'''Winter Abyss''' used to be lived in by people, though they abandoned it and moved over to [[Northern Lights]].<ref>https://x.com/Your_Adv/status/1996494132198637625</ref>
*The current version of '''Winter Abyss''' is styled around [[w:c:riskofrain2:Rallypoint Delta|Rallypoint Delta]] from ''Risk of Rain 2''.
*'''Winter Abyss''' replaced [[Winter]] in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]].
*In [[v1.80.0]], a remake for '''Winter Abyss''' was unintentionally released early. This would quickly be reverted.
